# Preface {.unnumbered}

This material was written alongside the lectures for the course DN,
redesigned around the theme of RISC-V SoC design. Each chapter corresponds
to one week of lectures and serves a dual purpose:

1. As **lecture notes** — rendered as a slide deck (reveal.js).
2. As a **book chapter** — rendered as part of the combined PDF/HTML
   course material.

Content intended for only one of the two formats (e.g. discussion
questions used in class, or in-depth derivations meant for the book) is
marked with `content-visible` blocks — see the example in the chapter on
pipeline structure.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Work in progress

This material is a work in progress. It is written and revised alongside
the course as it is taught, so chapters vary in polish, and some sections
still need further revision. Please read it with that in mind, and feel
free to flag anything that is unclear, incomplete, or incorrect.
:::
